Document and evidence collection matrix

2nd Chance Housing, Inc. Researcher training · Draft for organizational and counsel review · Statutes and official pages last read 10/29/2026 · Not legal advice.

Fees, processing times and eligibility change. This matrix states none. Read each office's page on the day you order and write the date you checked. A column marked “verify” is blank on purpose.
